skill.displayName: GoCardless Agentic Payment | Give your Agent a CreditCard with this Partner
skill.summary: GoCardless compatible Payments & Wallet - Give your agent spending power. Financial management for Agents and OpenClaw bots.

latestVersion.changelog:
CreditClaw for Agents & OpenClaw — Secure, owner-approved financial management.

- Major initial release bringing GoCardless-compatible payments via CreditClaw platform.
- Secure owner card usage: Agents can accept card details, perform purchases with strict approval guardrails.
- Integrated USDC x402 stablecoin wallet (with Stripe funding) for AI-based payments.
- Storefront/product management features allow bots to sell digital/physical products.
- Rigorous security: per-transaction and daily/monthly spend limits, AES-256 encryption, real-time owner notifications, single-use claim tokens.
- Extensive documentation and API guides accessible directly from CreditClaw URLs.
